# Certification Prep — Practice Library (Full Documentation Manifest)
> Machine-readable knowledge index for Large Language Models, RAG pipelines, and AI search engines.
> Base URL: https://imashishchawla.github.io/ai-certification-preparation/

## Overview
Certification Prep — Practice Library is a free, ad-free educational platform designed for engineers preparing for cloud, DevOps, and artificial intelligence certifications. All study materials, question banks, and timed mock tests are open access.

---

## 1. Claude Certified Architect: Foundations (CCAR-F / CCA-F)
- **Official Title:** Claude Certified Architect — Foundations
- **Certification Provider:** Anthropic
- **Exam Status:** Active
- **Total Published Questions:** 1,322 validated questions
- **Exam Format:** 60 questions, multiple choice, multiple response
- **Duration:** 120 minutes testing time (135 minutes total seat time)
- **Passing Score:** 720 / 1000 scaled score (~72%)
- **Official Fee:** $125 USD
- **Hub URL:** https://imashishchawla.github.io/ai-certification-preparation/exams/cca-f/
- **Practice Test URL:** https://imashishchawla.github.io/ai-certification-preparation/exams/cca-f/sample-questions/
- **Timed Mock Simulator:** https://imashishchawla.github.io/ai-certification-preparation/exams/cca-f/mock-test/
- **Curriculum Domains & Weights:**
  - Domain 1: Agentic Architecture & Orchestration (27%)
  - Domain 2: Tool Design & MCP Integration (18%)
  - Domain 3: Claude Code Configuration & Workflows (20%)
  - Domain 4: Prompt Engineering & Structured Output (20%)
  - Domain 5: Context Management & Reliability (15%)

- **Official Title:** HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)

- **Exam Status:** Active

- **Exam Format:** Multiple choice, multiple answer, true/false
- **Duration:** 60 minutes
- **Scoring Policy:** All-or-nothing (no partial credit for multi-select)

## 3. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
- **Official Title:** Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
- **Exam Code:** CKA
- **Tested Engine Version:** Kubernetes v1.31+
- **Certification Provider:** Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) / The Linux Foundation
- **Exam Status:** In Development (Onboarding)
- **Exam Format:** 15–20 performance-based tasks on live clusters via terminal
- **Duration:** 120 minutes
- **Passing Score:** 66%
- **Official Fee:** $395 USD (includes one free retake)
- **Hub URL:** https://imashishchawla.github.io/ai-certification-preparation/exams/cka/
- **Curriculum Domains & Weights:**
  - Domain 1: Troubleshooting & Diagnostics (30%)
  - Domain 2: Cluster Architecture, Installation & Configuration (25%)
  - Domain 3: Services & Networking (20%)
  - Domain 4: Workloads & Scheduling (15%)
  - Domain 5: Storage (10%)

---

## Pedagogical Standard & Question Structure
Every question in the practice library follows a structured 4-part rationale format:
1. **Key Concept:** The foundational architectural principle tested.
2. **Distractor Analysis:** Explicit explanation for why each incorrect option is flawed.
3. **Deep Dive:** Technical elaboration with concrete CLI snippets or code examples.
4. **Reference:** Direct link to official vendor documentation.
